name: EPIC 247424603

text.card: A red giant 4,162 parsecs away, 22 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.24 solar masses and 22.1 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,705 K at its surface.
